newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Lucky Goldstar explores ties with Israel.
newsitem.headline: Lucky Goldstar explores ties with Israel.

text.p: A group of 17 executives from South Korea's Lucky Goldstar Group are in Israel for a four-day visit to explore ties with Israeli companies, the Israel Export Institute said on Wednesday.

The group, headed by Huh Chang Soo, chairman of Lucky Goldstar's LG Cable subsidiary, will be visiting oil refining, chemical, electronic, communications, computer and civil engineering concerns, the institute said. They will be looking for suppliers, joint venture undertakings and investment opportunities.

Last June, Lucky Goldstar won an $85 million tender (including options) for high-tension cable from the state-controlled Israel Electric Corp. The tender requires Lucky Goldstar to transfer know-how for making the cable to an Israeli company.

Lucky Goldstar, South Korea's third-largest conglomerate, has been investing heavily outside its home country in recent years. The head of the delegation said the conglomerate hoped that 85 percent of its activities would be outside South Korea by the year 2000.
